svg.title: 31 · FDC / WH_Channel/Logic
svg.text: ADDED · Conflicting return/removal facts invalidate the timer; Ignition owns disposition.
ADDED · Remember the consumed physical-source sequence after its checks.
ADDED · Post: the dispatch RTO has already executed once; sample its millisecond accumulator.
ADDED · Physical removal: 10 -> 20 after measuring the removal scan; retain elapsed value.
ADDED · Native timer completion/exhaustion or invalid accumulator latches timer fault 21.
ADDED · Evaluate publication once, before changing CaptureState; no jump or label is required.
ADDED · Freeze the post-legacy item and measured timer in the same event.
